subject: Confirming payee routing + structured remittance snapshot (CSV sample)
messages:
From: Nora Jenkins <nora.jenkins@ledgerflow.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: payments@ledgerflow.com
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: New vendor banking + remittance sample for Redwood

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the onboarding checklist — attaching our banking proof and a sample remittance CSV so your team can validate mapping. Please confirm the field you expect for the PO reference and whether you need a separate invoice file or embedded invoice_number column.

Attachments: bank_info.pdf (PDF), sample_remit.csv (CSV)

What we include in the sample_remit.csv: vendor_account, routing_number, account_type, po_reference, invoice_number, amount, currency, remit_notes

We can change the column names if Redwood needs a specific key for automated reconciliation. We'll also prepare a micro-deposit for ACH verification once you confirm the routing.

Best,
Nora Jenkins
Head of Finance Operations
LedgerFlow Inc.
Nora.Jenkins@ledgerflow.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Nora Jenkins <nora.jenkins@ledgerflow.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New vendor banking + remittance sample for Redwood

Nora — thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround. A few clarifying items so finance can automate reconciliation cleanly: 

- Account type: please indicate ACH or Wire explicitly in the account_type column (we prefer "ACH" or "WIRE").
- PO key: our system expects a PO identifier in a field named "po_number" (case-insensitive); if you send "po_reference" that's fine but please confirm mapping.
- Remit string: for the one-line remittance we accept the following pattern for bank-ledger correlation: remit_reference=PO12345;invoice=INV-2027-998;amount=12500.00;currency=USD;acct_last4=6789
- Timezone/CSV encoding: UTF-8 CSV, header row required.

Can you confirm you'll include "po_number" or agree that we map your "po_reference" -> "po_number" during ingest? Once confirmed, we'll request a micro-deposit to validate the ACH route and run a single test payout.

Thanks — cc'ing Jonas to confirm the PO labeling we use on Redwood's side.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Vendor Onboarding Manager, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Nora Jenkins <nora.jenkins@ledgerflow.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2027 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New vendor banking + remittance sample for Redwood

On Wed, Dec 8, 2027 at 10:03 AM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com> wrote:
> Nora — thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround. A few clarifying items so finance can automate reconciliation cleanly: ...

Quick note from finance ops — we can map po_reference -> po_number during the ingest step but prefer you provide po_number to avoid manual work. Our required columns for the structured remit CSV are: 

- remit_id (unique per row)
- po_number
- invoice_number
- amount
- currency
- remit_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- acct_last4 (last 4 digits of receiving account)
- remit_notes (optional)

Example single-row CSV that will ingest cleanly:
remit_20271208_001,PO-45213,INV-2027-998,12500.00,USD,2027-12-08,6789,First test payment

Next steps: 
1) Nora/ledgerflow team confirms you'll include po_number or allow mapping.
2) Once confirmed, Olga will request micro-deposit test for ACH verification.
3) After micro-deposit, LedgerFlow sends a signed banking attestation (PDF) and a final remittance batch for reconciliation testing.

I've attached a tiny example row as remit_sample_row.txt for your engineers.

—Jonas Weber
Lead, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Nora Jenkins <nora.jenkins@ledgerflow.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: payments@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2027 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New vendor banking + remittance sample for Redwood

Thanks, Olga and Jonas — confirmed. We'll: 

- Rename the column to "po_number" in the CSV we send to Redwood.
- Include remit_id and acct_last4 as requested.
- Prepare bank_info_attestation.pdf and send a micro-deposit to the ACH account today (ETA 24-48 hours).
- Provide a test remittance file to payments@redwood.com after the micro-deposit completes; it will follow the sample row format you provided.

I attached an updated sample_remit.csv with the renamed header and one example row; bank_info.pdf is the banking proof. Let me know if you'd like us to run the file through SFTP or upload to the Drive link you shared.

Appreciate the quick coordination — we want reconciliation to be as automated as possible.

Best,
Nora Jenkins
Head of Finance Operations
LedgerFlow Inc.
nora.jenkins@ledgerflow.com
